title: Temperature: Reading Thermometers and Temperature Differences
seo_title: Grade 6 Temperature Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Measure and record temperature in degrees Celsius (°C) using thermometers; read and compare temperatures.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 6 temperature worksheets: reading thermometers, likely temperatures, differences and temperature tables. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Read what each mark on the thermometer is worth.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Temperature is measured in degrees Celsius (°C) with a thermometer.
  • Water freezes at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C. Our body is about 37 °C.
  • Find what each mark on the thermometer is worth before you read it.
  • To find a difference, subtract the lower temperature from the higher one.

Examples

Example

Upington 38 °C, Cape Town 24 °C

38 − 24

Answer: 14 °C warmer in Upington

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The wrong intervalWork out each mark first.
Subtracting the wrong wayHigher − lower.
Not sensibleA cold winter morning is about 5 °C, not 50 °C.
